data.exact_reserve_text: The 2021 net technical result of GBP 96.9m (2020: (GBP 26.2)m) includes GBP 68.4m (2020: GBP 45.0m) of releases from reserves in respect of prior accident years.
data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2021 gross claims outstanding were GBP 870.49m. During 2021 the Syndicate recorded gross prior year releases of GBP 68.392m (favourable development), representing a c.7.9% release relative to opening gross claims outstanding. The releases were reported across several classes (notably Marine, Property and Energy) while certain classes (eg. Reinsurance and Casualty) showed adverse movements. The net technical result statement explicitly attributes GBP 68.4m of releases to prior accident years.
raw_causal_phrases: includes GBP 68.4m (2020: GBP 45.0m) of releases from reserves in respect of prior accident years.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet liabilities comparative column (2020) on page 20. Prior year movement (gross) taken from Technical Provisions note (page 43) where total prior year releases are itemised (Total prior year releases 68,392). Lob level prior year movement figures are reported in the Technical Provisions note and used to populate lob_movements. A gross claims development triangle is present in the report (pages 44-45) but the development matrix rows were not fully transcribed here; if needed the triangle can be extracted directly from pages 44-45. All monetary figures are presented in the report currency (GBP) and converted from GBP 000 to millions for this JSON. Positive amounts denote strengthening (adverse), negative amounts denote releases (favourable).

_claims_triangle.note: Gross claims development table exists (pages 44-45) but development period rows were not fully transcribed in this extract. The table should be consulted directly for a full triangle if required.
